name: cold breath
desc:
**Cold Breath.** The [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} exhales an icy blast in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a  DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 58 (13d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
